phrases.title: API access
phrases.description: Create and manage personal tokens for external applications.
phrases.name: Name
phrases.api_actions_help: Select the API actions this token may call. Only actions currently available to your account are shown.
phrases.content_access_help: Limit the token to a subset of your current content permissions.
phrases.expires_help: Leave empty for a token without an expiration date.
phrases.token_name_help: Use a recognizable name such as Mobile app or CRM sync.
phrases.token_created_help: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
phrases.token_hint_help: Only this short hint is stored for identification. The full token cannot be recovered.
phrases.confirm_disable: Temporarily disable this token? Requests using it will be rejected until you enable it again.
phrases.confirm_revoke: Revoke this token permanently? It cannot be restored and applications using it will need a new token.
phrases.confirm_delete: Delete this revoked or expired token record?
phrases.invalid_expiry: Expiration date must be in the future.
phrases.access_denied: API access is not enabled for your user group.
phrases.no_content_permissions: No content permissions are currently available.
phrases.no_api_actions: No API actions are currently available.
